name: dsh-client-bind
description: Token-gated conversation-level machine binding for DeepSeek Harness web. First-step injection covers the bound machine plus a roster of every other configured machine. Entry URLs carry ?token=<deployment token>&ssh=<sshAlias>; the plugin authenticates the visit by token, resolves the machine by ssh alias, and injects a deterministic binding notice at the first agent step — strict matching, no IP guessing. Ships a Plugins-settings card (machines CRUD, per-machine agent notes, public-key listing from ~/.ssh for one-click copy) and self-hosts the visit beacon via an index script injection. · 令牌门禁的对话级机器绑定：?token=鉴权 + machine=ssh 别名绑定，配置界面管理机器/公钥/说明，免打补丁可独立发布。
